bugs.title: Appointment booking allows selecting past dates
bugs.description: The date picker in the appointment booking form does not disable past dates. Users can select dates that have already passed and successfully submit the booking.
bugs.detection_hint: Try booking an appointment for yesterday or last week

bugs.title: Email validation accepts invalid email formats
bugs.description: The patient registration form accepts invalid email formats such as 'test@' or 'user@.com'. The regex validation on the email field is too permissive.
bugs.detection_hint: Try registering with 'test@' as email

bugs.title: Patient search is case-sensitive
bugs.description: Searching for patients by name is case-sensitive. Searching 'john' does not return 'John Smith'. The search should be case-insensitive.
bugs.detection_hint: Search for a patient using lowercase when their name starts with uppercase

bugs.title: Double-booking: same doctor, same time slot, two patients
bugs.description: Two different patients can book the same doctor for the same date and time slot. There is no server-side uniqueness validation on the appointment slot.
bugs.detection_hint: Book two appointments for the same doctor at the same time using two browser tabs

bugs.title: Cancelling appointment does not free the time slot
bugs.description: When a patient cancels their appointment, the time slot remains marked as unavailable. Other patients cannot book that freed slot.
bugs.detection_hint: Book an appointment, cancel it, then try to book the same slot with another patient

bugs.title: Appointment time displays in UTC instead of local timezone
bugs.description: All appointment times are displayed in the server's timezone (UTC) rather than the user's local timezone. This causes confusion for users in different timezones.
bugs.detection_hint: Check if appointment times match your local timezone or show UTC

bugs.title: Discount percentage accepts negative and >100% values
bugs.description: The discount field in the billing module accepts negative values (which increases the price) and values over 100% (which results in negative totals). No boundary validation exists.
bugs.detection_hint: Try applying a -50% or 150% discount on an invoice

bugs.title: Patient age calculation off by one for edge-case DOBs
bugs.description: The age calculation in patient profiles shows incorrect age for patients whose birthday is today or in edge cases around year boundaries. Off-by-one error in date math.
bugs.detection_hint: Check the displayed age for a patient whose birthday is today

bugs.title: Total count on appointments list is wrong (off by 3)
bugs.description: The pagination control on the appointments list shows the wrong total number of records. The count doesn't update after filtering or when new appointments are added.
bugs.detection_hint: Check the 'showing X of Y' text on the appointments list and compare with actual records

bugs.title: IDOR: accessing other patients' records by changing ID
bugs.description: Changing the patient ID parameter in the URL or API request allows viewing other patients' full records without proper authorization checks. No ownership validation on the server side.
bugs.detection_hint: Login as Patient A, then change the patient ID in the URL to view Patient B's records

bugs.title: Stored XSS in doctor notes/prescription field
bugs.description: The patient notes/prescription field does not sanitize HTML or JavaScript input. Malicious scripts stored in notes execute when a doctor views them, enabling stored XSS attacks.
bugs.detection_hint: Enter <script>alert('XSS')</script> in the patient notes field and see if it executes when viewed

bugs.title: API returns SSN/insurance in patient list endpoint
bugs.description: API endpoints that return patient lists include sensitive fields like SSN, insurance number, and full medical history. List endpoints should only return summary data (name, ID, DOB).
bugs.detection_hint: Call the patient list API and inspect the response — does it include SSN or insurance numbers?

bugs.title: JWT token has 7-day expiry, no refresh rotation
bugs.description: JWT tokens are issued with a 7-day expiry and there is no refresh token rotation mechanism. A stolen token remains valid for 7 days with no way to revoke it.
bugs.detection_hint: Decode the JWT token (jwt.io) and check the exp claim — note the long validity period

bugs.title: No rate limiting on login endpoint
bugs.description: The login API endpoint has no rate limiting or account lockout mechanism. An attacker can make unlimited login attempts, enabling brute-force password attacks.
bugs.detection_hint: Send 50+ rapid login requests with wrong passwords — the endpoint never blocks or slows down

bugs.title: Password hash leaked in profile API response
bugs.description: The user profile API endpoint includes the password_hash field in its response. This exposes the hashed password to any authenticated user viewing their profile.
bugs.detection_hint: Call the profile/user API and check if password_hash appears in the JSON response

bugs.title: Appointments endpoint returns all records (no pagination)
bugs.description: The 'All Appointments' API endpoint returns every appointment record in a single response with no server-side pagination. With large datasets, this causes slow load times and high memory usage.
bugs.detection_hint: Call GET /api/appointments without limit/offset parameters and check if it returns all records

bugs.title: N+1 query problem on doctor dashboard
bugs.description: The doctor dashboard makes a separate database query for each appointment to fetch patient details, resulting in an N+1 query problem. With 30 appointments, it runs 31 queries instead of 2.
bugs.detection_hint: Open the doctor dashboard and monitor network requests — notice multiple sequential API calls for patient data

bugs.title: No caching on doctor availability endpoint
bugs.description: Every time a user checks doctor availability (which happens on each date selection), a fresh database query runs. There is no caching, causing unnecessary load on the database.
bugs.detection_hint: Select different dates repeatedly and watch the network tab — every selection triggers a fresh API call

bugs.title: Missing database indexes on key columns
bugs.description: The database tables lack indexes on appointment_date and doctor_id columns, which are used in almost every query. This causes full table scans and slow performance under load.
bugs.detection_hint: Check the database schema — key columns lack indexes. Query performance degrades with more data.

bugs.title: No loading indicator when booking appointment
bugs.description: When a user clicks 'Book Appointment', there is no loading spinner or visual feedback. Users tend to click multiple times, potentially creating duplicate bookings.
bugs.detection_hint: Click the Book Appointment button and notice there's no visual indication that the request is processing

bugs.title: Generic error messages ('Something went wrong')
bugs.description: All error messages display a generic 'Something went wrong' text without any useful information about what failed or how to fix it.
bugs.detection_hint: Trigger any error (e.g., submit invalid data) and observe the generic error message

bugs.title: Form clears all fields after validation error
bugs.description: When a form submission fails validation (e.g., missing required field), all previously entered data is cleared. Users have to re-enter everything from scratch.
bugs.detection_hint: Fill out the registration form, leave one required field empty, submit, and see if other fields retain their data

bugs.title: No confirmation dialog for cancel/delete actions
bugs.description: Clicking the 'Cancel Appointment' button immediately cancels without any confirmation dialog. Users can accidentally cancel appointments with a single misclick.
bugs.detection_hint: Click cancel on any appointment — it cancels immediately with no 'Are you sure?' prompt

bugs.title: Date picker allows weekends (clinic closed Sat/Sun)
bugs.description: The appointment date picker allows selecting Saturday and Sunday, but no doctors have availability on weekends. Users select weekend dates, see no available slots, and get confused with no explanation.
bugs.detection_hint: Try booking an appointment on a Saturday or Sunday — note the confusing empty availability

bugs.title: Medical history visible to admin (should be doctor-only)
bugs.description: Receptionists/admins can view patient medical history, prescriptions, and clinical notes. This sensitive medical data should only be accessible to doctors and the patient themselves.
bugs.detection_hint: Login as admin/receptionist and navigate to a patient's profile — medical history and prescriptions are visible

bugs.title: Patient SSN exposed in appointment API response
bugs.description: The appointment listing API endpoint includes the patient's SSN in the response payload. SSN should never be returned in appointment-related endpoints.
bugs.detection_hint: Call the appointments API and inspect the JSON — SSN field is included in patient data

bugs.title: No audit log for patient record access
bugs.description: There is no audit trail logging who accessed patient records, when, and what they viewed. This violates healthcare data privacy requirements (HIPAA-like compliance).
bugs.detection_hint: Access multiple patient records and check if there's any log of these accesses anywhere in the system

bugs.title: Soft-deleted records still accessible via direct API
bugs.description: When a patient record is deleted, it's soft-deleted in the database but still accessible via direct API call using the patient ID. Deleted records should not be retrievable.
bugs.detection_hint: Delete a patient, then try accessing their record directly via API using their ID — data is still returned

bugs.title: Sensitive data in URL query parameters
bugs.description: Patient search and filtering passes sensitive data (name, DOB, SSN) as URL query parameters in GET requests. This data appears in browser history, server logs, and proxy logs.
bugs.detection_hint: Perform a patient search and check the browser URL — sensitive data appears in the query string
